content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Specialty chemical ingredients for formulators, not food processing or packing of vegetables, fruit or snacks."},{"label":"C2","good":true,"reason":"Sells canned and frozen vegetables and snacks to the same grocery and foodservice channels, with a similar mix of owned brands and manufacturing."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Branded protein shakes and sports nutrition made by outsourced manufacturers, not vegetable or fruit processing."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Household, personal care and vitamin consumer brands, unrelated to packaged food processing."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Bottles and distributes beverages on route-based delivery, a different business from packing vegetables and fruit."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Fresh refrigerated pet food made in company kitchens, not packaged human vegetables or fruit."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Processes meat, poultry and prepared meals; shares grocery customers but not vegetable or fruit processing."},{"label":"C8","good":true,"reason":"Processes and freezes vegetables (potatoes) in its own plants for foodservice and retail grocery, similar to frozen vegetable processing."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Spices, seasonings and condiments with flavor systems, a different product set from canned or frozen vegetables and fruit."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Packaged beverages such as sparkling water and soft drinks, not canned or frozen food processing."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Household disposables like foil, wrap and bags, sold to the same retailers but a different product business."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Makes metal and plastic packaging containers for food companies, not the packed food products themselves."},{"label":"C13","good":true,"reason":"Makes private-label fruit snacks and fruit ingredients in its own plants for grocers, overlapping with Seneca's fruit and snack processing."},{"label":"C14","good":false,"reason":"Brand owner of protein bars and shakes made by contract manufacturers, not vegetable or fruit processing."}]}
